excerpt: The event made my old assumptions about fairness feel impossible to hold.
I had a clear goal for my life, and suddenly that future was gone.
I kept asking what this experience meant and whether my life still had direction.
Prayer helped me reinterpret the event without pretending it was good.
For a while I felt abandoned by God and angry during worship.
I began to see that the event was part of my story, but not the whole story.
My priorities changed, and relationships became more important than achievement.
I still remember the stress, but I can imagine a future again.
